notation: G^{0|\circ}: the small round superscript is graphically compatible with zero or circle. The first occurrence carries \unsure{0|\circ}; subsequent occurrences use 0 provisionally, not as a mathematical correction.
The named map is \sigma|r:S\to A; the hooked initial glyph remains doubtful.
The action variable is u_{\omega|w}; the two-bowl subscript remains unresolved.
Source abbreviations on this page include gpe, ens, card, gén., néc./néc and autom. Their presence or absence of a full stop is retained individually.
The element-word abbreviation is best read éléts, with élémts retained; the fully expanded éléments is not written.
Item 2 bis writes G, without a round superscript, both as codomain of i and in gén. de G. No G^0 is supplied.
hand_habits: The writer compresses n, u, and several joined lower-case letters into long nearly horizontal strokes with short upturns/downturns; small connectors can therefore resemble dashes.
The g descender in générateur returns far to the left; this is a letter stroke, not an underline beneath the word.
Small upper hooks and lower turns form the numeral 2; the numeral 3 has two rightward bowls. Numerals were inspected independently of the mathematical claim.
The same main ink hand becomes lighter and more broken in the lower remarks, while tall l, p descenders and the crossed t remain useful letter anchors.
A full stop is present after the first néc. but absent after the second néc, ens, autom, and the lower i.e.
notes: Current page only: packet scan007, common RULES/PREAMBLE, and shared notation table were the permitted inputs. No other page or global witness was opened.

Full page viewed once for layout, then both provided halves once. Every word and symbol, including C/H agreements, was compared in source order. The 50 first-reader crops were each inspected once; no OCR, web lookup, or TeX compilation was used.

An attempted four-image emission immediately before context compaction returned only a truncation error. Those images were first actually inspected in the successful later emission; no second usable visual inspection occurred.

All crops are original-full-image coordinate crops, PIL autocontrasted and LANCZOS enlarged to a longest side of 2200 pixels, saved as JPEG quality 94. No crop rotation was required: no slanted marginal note is present.
